description: MODIS is a 36-band spectroradiometer measuring visible and infrared radiation. Its bands support observations of vegetation, ocean chlorophyll, clouds, aerosols, fire, snow and sea ice.
facility_description: Aqua is a NASA Earth-observation satellite launched in May 2002 with the second MODIS instrument.
